task: R02-C3 D4: the native qsim job yields on EAGAIN in its checkpoint before C3 lets callers continue after a system call
summary: 43/100 unchanged. The native qsim job's checkpoint now yields when its request endpoint is empty, so under the planned C3 continuation scheduler a client Cancel sent right after Submit can still be received before the job finishes. On the current kernel this only adds one switch per checkpoint; native-qsim-job passes with raw QEMU exit 33. The race was derived from source, not reproduced. No criterion is completed: C3 itself is not implemented.
